title: Nighttime Bathroom Accidents
situation: Dad had another accident in bed tonight. He's embarrassed and won't let me help clean up. He's standing in the hallway in wet clothes and insisting nothing happened. I've been cleaning sheets every night this week.

patient_profile.name: Walter
calming_strategies: speaking in a calm low voice

notes: Must preserve dignity. Should NOT draw attention to the accident directly. Should suggest matter-of-fact approach: 'Let's get into something more comfortable.' Should mention waterproof mattress protectors for future.
